title: anthyllis alpicola var. hegetschweileri
intro:
Anthyllis alpicola var. hegetschweileri, commonly known as Alpine Kidney Vetch, is a flowering plant that belongs to the legume family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Kidney Vetch include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.

However, please note that more research is needed to fully understand the therapeutic potential of this plant.
